name: Café of Roses
source:
It's early autumn, and the leaves are beginning to brown. Meike, a young woman who lives and works in the German city of Augsburg, wishes she could enjoy the peaceful atmosphere and the balmy weather, but she has a problem.

Meike's parents are determined to set her up with the wealthy young entrepeneur, Walter: a man who, at the age of thirty-two, successfully founded his own company, and who exudes self-confidence. Meike's mother, in particular, is determined to see her daughter married, and Meike is being harangued into a relationship with this man she does not love.

Tired and stressed, Meike decides to escape Walter one day by ducking into a quaint Victorian-inspired café where her friend, Henny, works...

But, in her visit to Café of Roses, Meike meets a young woman who will change the course of her life forever. Who is the mysterious Magdalena, with her fair hair and her red eyes, and why does she look so familiar...?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3934290/Cafe_of_Roses/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
时值初秋，树叶开始变黄。梅克是一位在德国奥格斯堡生活和工作的年轻女子，她希望能够享受宁静的氛围和宜人的天气，但她有一个问题。

梅克的父母决定让她和富有的年轻企业家沃尔特在一起：沃尔特在三十二岁时成功地创立了自己的公司，并且散发着自信。尤其是梅克的母亲，决心让她的女儿结婚，而梅克却被长篇大论地与这个她不爱的男人发生关系。

疲惫不堪、压力重重的梅克有一天决定躲进一家古色古香的维多利亚风格咖啡馆，躲避沃尔特，她的朋友亨尼就在那里工作……

但是，在参观玫瑰咖啡馆时，梅克遇到了一位年轻女子，她将永远改变她的人生轨迹。金发红眼的神秘玛格达莱娜是谁，为何看起来如此眼熟……？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3934290/Cafe_of_Roses/]Steam[/url]]
